dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ah, yes. NU Academy.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Normal Unity Academy.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where students arrive from every nation, every background, every walk of life.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: United under one roof.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Learning, growing, experiencing side by side.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: No discrimination. No prejudice. No favoring one place over another.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At least, that's the idea.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: And you, my friend, are about to experience it firsthand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rare kind of peace, in your own generation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You'll learn who you are here.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Or maybe, who you become.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Life has a way of changing people.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: And someone young, like you, is exactly the kind who changes easiest.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: So. Let's see who you'll be by the end of this.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your first day starts now.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Class just let out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wander the hallway, still half-thinking about the Computer Science lecture.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Genuinely. Harder than curing cancer.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You're fairly sure of it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At least curing cancer doesn't punish a missing semicolon.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lost in that thought, you keep walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then you see it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A door. Unremarkable, really.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't know why you stop in front of it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't know why your hand is already raised.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Maybe it's nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Or maybe, somehow, this is exactly where you're supposed to be.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You knock.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The door swings open before you can even lower your hand.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...Can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Because from where I'm standing, someone just knocked on a door for no reason.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Which, last I checked, isn't a thing normal people do.

choices.text: "Woah! Easy, I'm just curious. No need for the hostility."

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: "Easy"?

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: You knock on a random door with no reason, and I'm the hostile one.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Curious. Sure. That's a word for it.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: So what do you actually want?

choices.text: "...Honestly? I don't know. It just felt right."

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: It "felt right."

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: That's not an answer, that's a horoscope.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: So what do you actually want?

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Penny.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: That's not how you greet a guest.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: They knocked for no reason.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: That doesn't mean you get to interrogate them on the doorstep.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...Fine. Whatever.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Penny steps back, arms crossed, still watching you carefully.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I'm Yuri. Vice President of this club.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Please, come in.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Wait, we don't even know if they-

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: We're happy to have you.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Truly. I apologize for the door.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: It won't happen again.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Yuri steps aside, holding the door open.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Whatever compelled you to knock, it's led you here.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step inside.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The room is warmer than the hallway. Papers, sketches, and half-finished projects cover every table.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Five people are inside.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Penny and Yuri, already familiar.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: That's not really how I'd put it.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: No, I know, I just mean-

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: It's fine. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ali tries again. It doesn't quite land the second time either.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Erika's calm has a way of taking the wind out of a room.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Across the room, John watches quietly, saying nothing.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Hey. We have a guest.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Wait, seriously?

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Nobody told me we had a guest.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: I'm Ali. President of the Creative Arts Club.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Erika studies you for a moment. Quiet. Deliberate.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Let me guess.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Curious about the club everyone calls the "Dere Club" behind our backs.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: It happens more than you'd think.

choices.text: "Oh, no, I just wanted to see what the club was about."

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: That counts!

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: You should join. Seriously, we'd love to have you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You politely decline, at least for now.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: ...Okay. Fair. Worth a shot.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: It's what people call us.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: This club tends to attract... unique people.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Ali, for example, gets a little too excited whenever someone shows interest.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: It puts a lot of unintended pressure on people.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Ali, ignore what I just said.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: She's not wrong.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: I take offense to that.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: You kind of just proved her point.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: ...I did not.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Anyway.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: What actually brings you here?

choices.text: "Honestly... I just wanted to see who was in here."

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: That's a surprisingly honest answer.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I like that more than you'd think.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: It's still a weird answer.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: But I guess weird tracks, considering the door thing.

choices.text: "I heard rumors about this club. Wanted to see for myself."

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Rumors.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Interesting. Which version did you hear?

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Please say the good version.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You admit you're not entirely sure there was a "good version."

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: ...Yeah, that tracks too.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The conversation settles into something easier after that.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Not quite comfortable. Not yet. But not so much like standing in a stranger's living room, either.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: You don't have to decide anything today, you know.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Whether you join, I mean.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Most people don't.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Most people also don't knock on doors for no reason.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: So maybe don't compare them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somewhere outside, a bell rings, muffled through the walls.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: That's the period bell.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: You should probably get to your next class.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: But you're welcome back. Whenever.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Yeah, seriously, come back!

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: ...It was good to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: See you around, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...Don't knock next time. Just come in.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: It's less weird that way.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step back out into the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The door closes softly behind you, and for a moment you just stand there.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Five names. Five very different people.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You didn't plan for any of this. You still don't fully understand why you knocked.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: But something about that room didn't feel like nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Class isn't over yet, though.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's still the rest of the day to get through.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lunch period. The courtyard is packed, noisy, alive.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You spot Ali before he spots you - he's got a clipboard, a sign-up sheet, and the look of someone one rejection away from being politely ignored by everyone.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Oh - hey! You!

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, actually.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: We're doing a mural for the club fair next month. Recruiting hands, not talent. Talent's optional.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: You interested?

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Wait, really?

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Okay, don't take this the wrong way, but you're like, the third person all day who didn't immediately say no.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: I'll take it. Seriously, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He scribbles your name down before you can change your mind, grinning the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: Ha - yeah, that's fine.

dialogue.speaker: ali
dialogue.text: You say that, but you already came by the club once today, so I've got hope.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He says it lightly, but there's something a little hopeful underneath it too.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone else calls his name from across the courtyard, and just like that, he's off again - clipboard raised, smile already back on.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The library is nearly empty this period. You find Erika at a corner table, surrounded by color-coded folders, working in complete silence.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: You found me.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: That wasn't difficult, I imagine. I'm always here.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Did you need something, or is this a social visit?

choices.text: "Just wanted to say hi. What are you working on?"

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: ...A social visit, then.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Club budgeting. Ali has excellent ideas and no concept of what things cost.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: Someone has to be the adult in the room. It's usually me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She says it flatly, but there's the faintest trace of fondness underneath it.

choices.text: "No, I'll let you focus. Sorry to bother you."

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: It wasn't a bother.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: You're allowed to interrupt me. I would have told you if it were a bad time.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's about as close to "stay" as Erika is likely to say out loud.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: In any case. I hope the rest of your classes go well.

dialogue.speaker: erika
dialogue.text: That's not a dismissal. I mean it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You almost don't notice John, tucked into a window alcove near the stairwell, sketchbook balanced on his knee.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He notices you first, and immediately looks like he regrets it.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Oh - hey.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: You don't have to stop. I'm just, uh. Killing time.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He closes the sketchbook a little too quickly.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Nothing, really. It's not-

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He hesitates, then opens the sketchbook back up, just a little.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: It's just the courtyard. From up here it looks kind of nice, actually.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Nobody's really seen this one yet.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He says it like it's no big deal. It clearly is.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: ...Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: I mean - you didn't have to. But thanks.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He relaxes, just slightly, once you're not looking directly at him anymore.

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Anyway. See you around, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He goes back to his sketchbook before you've even finished walking away.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Near the lockers, you hear Penny before you see her, already mid-argument with a vending machine.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: This is theft. Actual theft. I put in exact change.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She hits the machine once, purely out of principle, and it does absolutely nothing.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...Don't laugh.

choices.text: "I wasn't going to say anything." (smile anyway)

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: You were absolutely about to laugh.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: I can see it on your face. It's very obvious.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She crosses her arms, but there's no real heat behind it.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Oh, sure, because you'll definitely succeed where I failed.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You give the machine a light tap. The snack drops without complaint.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...Okay, that's actually infuriating.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Here. Half of it's yours. Don't make it weird.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: Anyway. This didn't happen. I have a reputation.

dialogue.speaker: penny
dialogue.text: ...See you at the club. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: By the time classes end for the day, the halls have mostly emptied out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You find Yuri standing just outside the clubroom door, alone, hands folded, watching the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's not clear how long she's been standing there.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: You came back this way.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I wasn't sure you would. Most people say "whenever" and mean "never."

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I'm glad you're not most people.

choices.text: "Were you waiting out here for me?"

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: ...Yes.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Is that strange? I don't mind if it is.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I just wanted to make sure I didn't miss you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's something quietly intense in the way she says it - like missing you wasn't really an option she was prepared to allow.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Of course. You should rest.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I'll be here tomorrow. And the day after.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: For as long as you keep coming back, I suppose.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's said gently. It still lingers a little longer than it probably should.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: Get home safely.

dialogue.speaker: yuri
dialogue.text: I'll be thinking about today. I imagine I'll think about it for a while, actually.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: By the time you get back to your room, the sky outside has gone the color of an old bruise - orange fading into something darker.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit for a while without doing much of anything.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ali, hopeful and a little too eager. Erika, careful with her words but not with her honesty. John, quiet until he wasn't. Penny, prickly right up until she wasn't. Yuri...

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Yuri is harder to put into words. You're not sure "waiting for you" is something people usually do on a first day.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You're not sure it's a bad thing, either. Not yet.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One knock on one door, and somehow you already have five people who know your face.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, you'll have to decide what to do with that.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tonight, though, you let yourself stop thinking about it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your first day at NU Academy is over.
